title: ADEEBA ANWAR(Legal Heir) versus UTTARAKHAND PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION

paras.text:
UKHC010036782026
2026:UHC:7748
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition Service Single No. 739 of 2026
31 August, 2026
Adeeba Anwar --Petitioner
Versus
Uttarakhand Public Service Commission and Others
--Respondents
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Presence:- Mr. T.A. Khan, learned senior counsel assisted by Ms. Jasmin
Wahid, learned counsel holding brief of Mr. Vinay Bhatt, learned
counsel for petitioner.
Mr. Pankaj Migalani, learned counsel for the respondent no.1-
Commission.
Mr. Narain Dutt, learned Standing Counsel with Mr. Prem
Prakash Bhatt, learned Brief Holder for the State of
Uttarakhand/respondent No.2.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J. (Oral)
Petitioner has filed the present writ petition
seeking the following reliefs:
i. To issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari quashing
the selection list dated 13.02.2026 issued by the respondent No.1
(Annexure No.1 to the writ petition) so far as it bears the roll
no.831462 for the recruitment on the post of Lecturer Biology in
General Branch (OBC Category).
ii. To issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari quashing
the detailed programme dated 25.02.2026 (Annexure No.10 to the
writ petition), by which the respondent no.1 has issued a detailed
programme of document verification pertaining to the selection of
Lecturer in Biology (General Branch) OBC Category so far as it
includes the Roll No. 831462 of the respondent No.3 and does not
have the Roll No. of the petitioner.
iii. To issue a writ, order, or direction in the nature of mandamus
commanding the respondent no. 1 to include the name and Roll
number of the petitioner in the selection list dated 13.02.2026 for the
recruitment of Lecturer in (General Branch) in OBC Category in lieu
of the Roll No.831462 (respondent No.3).
iv. To issue a writ, order of direction in the nature of mandamus
commanding the respondent No.1 to include the name of the
petitioner in the list of selected candidates for the post of Lecturer
Biology (General Branch) in OBC Category and it may further be
directed to conduct the document verification of the petitioner and
thereafter the respondent No. 2 may further be directed to issue a
letter of appointment in favour of the petitioner for the post of
Lecturer in Biology (General Branch) in OBC Category.
2. It is the case of the petitioner that the petitioner
participated in the selection process of the Lecturer (Biology)
pursuant to the Advertisement dated 09.10.2020. The result
1

2026:UHC:7748
of the selection was declared on 31.05.2022, but due to some
technical error in the selection of the Lecturer in Biology
(General and Women Branch), the amended select list/merit
list was published on 10.06.2022 (Annexure 6 to the writ
petition). In the said select list, the name of the petitioner was
not there, however, respondent No.3 was selected under
Women Branch.
3. Consequently, respondent No.3 was issued an
appointment letter on 05.08.2022 and she joined accordingly
on the post of Lecturer (Biology) in Women Branch.
4. The main contention of the petitioner is that since the
respondent No.3 was already given appointment on the post
of Lecturer (Biology) Women Branch, therefore, the name of
the petitioner has wrongly figured in document verification
list on 13.02.2026 (Annexure No.1 to the writ petition).
5. Per Contra, learned counsel for the respondent No.2-
Commission submits that the selection of the respondent
No.3 was made earlier in the year 2022 and she was
accordingly given appointment in the year 2022 against the
vacancy of the Lecturer (Biology) Women Branch, wherein,
she claimed reservation for UF (under Female) OBC Category
also. Now, the impugned document verification list dated
13.02.2026 (Annexure No.1) was issued pursuant to the
vacancies meant for physically challenged candidates, which
were interchanged to the physically challenged candidates
and in case of non-availability of the physically challenged
candidates, the same vacancies would be filled up by the
particular category of the candidates. Since respondent No.3
has applied under the UF (under Female) OBC Category and
she made an application for the Lecturer Biology in General
Branch too, therefore, her name found figured in the
document verification list.
6. Learned counsel for the respondent No.2-commission
has also supplied the result of the backlog of the physically
2

UKHC010036782026
2026:UHC:7748
challenged candidates dated 03.08.2026, which is taken on
record and it is contended that the selection has been over
and meritorious candidate than that of the petitioner has
already been selected, therefore, the petitioner has no claim
against any of the said vacancies, and accordingly, the writ
deserves to be dismissed.
7. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and
perused the records, this Court is of the view that the writ
petition, which has been filed by the petitioner, is totally
misconceived and the same has been filed on wrong
information of the facts of the case. First of all, the Annexure
No.1 is not the select list rather it is a document verification
list, in which the name of the respondent No.3 was figured
due to the reasons stated herein above and explained by the
counsel for the respondent-Commission. There is nothing
wrong and surprising in the name of the respondent No.3
figured in document verification list dated 13.02.2026 as
explained by the commission. Thus, there is no illegality and
arbitrariness in the selection of respondent No.3. In such view
of the matter, no interference is required.
8. Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed.
9. Pending Application stands disposed of.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) 31.08.2026
R.Bisht
